title: A 5th soldier injured in CFB Wainwright fire has died: DND
summary: A fifth soldier has died as a result of the fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, the Department of National Defence says.

image.caption: On Saturday, the Department of National Defence confirmed that Pte. William Douglas Dal Bianco died as a result of injures sustained in the fire at CFB Wainwright last month. (Submitted by the Department of National Defence)

blocks.text: A fifth soldier has died as a result of the fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, the Department of National Defence says.
5 total service members have now died because of incident on Oct. 17

Pte. William Douglas Dal Bianco, of the 3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia's Canadian Light Infantry (3 PPCLI), died in an Ontario hospital Friday from injuries he sustained in the fire on Oct. 17, the department said in a news release on Saturday.

National Defence Minister David McGuinty and military officials, including Gen. Jennie Carignan, the country's top soldier, were quoted in the release, offering condolences to loved ones and troops who knew him.
"We will honour his dedicated service and continue to stand with all those affected by this tragedy along the difficult road ahead," Carignan said.
